mapper.select: SELECT id, faq_id, question, answer, question_embedding, answer_embedding, combined_embedding FROM faq_vector_store
SELECT id, doc_id, chunk_index, chunk_content, chunk_embedding, chunk_metadata FROM knowledge_vector_store
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO faq_vector_store (faq_id, question, answer, question_embedding, answer_embedding, combined_embedding) VALUES (#{faqId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{questionEmbedding}, #{answerEmbedding}, #{combinedEmbedding})
INSERT INTO knowledge_vector_store (doc_id, chunk_index, chunk_content, chunk_embedding, chunk_metadata) VALUES (#{docId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkContent}, #{chunkEmbedding}, #{chunkMetadata})
